## Outcome

Describe the user-visible change and its canonical component owner.

## Evidence

- [ ] I ran the changed tests.
- [ ] I ran the incremental P10-P14 suite or documented why it is not applicable.
- [ ] Candidate SkillOpt settings, if any, were tested under their own hash.
- [ ] Public documentation and provenance metadata are updated.

## Guard review

- [ ] Method-change collision invalidation is not weakened.
- [ ] Literature-producing paths retain clickable official HTTPS links.
- [ ] Discipline changes preserve first-use initialization, non-journal forms, and profile-hash invalidation.
- [ ] PASS claims remain bounded to recorded evidence and artifacts.
- [ ] No new ambient executable or implicit download is introduced.
- [ ] The 512 MiB total, one-worker, one-thread, no-GPU contract is preserved.
- [ ] Overlap has one canonical owner and the MCP surface remains bounded.

## Privacy and licensing

- [ ] No credential, private paper, provider response, personal path, or unreleased data is included.
- [ ] Added upstreams include official URL, license, immutable revision, and admission decision.
